lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 2 -- My Team
lesson.grammar_point: there is / there are (+ plural nouns and numbers)

listenings.text: Good morning. This is Paul Adams. Welcome to floor twelve. There are ten desks here, and there is one meeting room. There is a small kitchen too. Your desk is number seven, near the window. There are twelve people in this office today. On Friday there is coffee for everybody at four. Have a good first day.

Hi, Ricardo. This is Diane. One question about your team in São Paulo. There are twenty-five people, is that right? And how many managers are there? Here in Miami there are two managers and there is one director. Our meeting room is small, so we are only six people in the room. Please send me the names of your team before Monday. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Diane sends a note about the Miami team. There is one director in the note. There are two managers in the note. The office is on floor twelve. On Monday there is a meeting at nine.
